title.ja: UC-05-01 渋滞前の早期休憩提案（Cさん・20代前半女性）
title.en: UC-05-01 Early rest before a heavy jam (Ms. C, early-20s woman)

brief.ja: 推し活で寝不足のまま、みなとみらいから御殿場へ土曜夕方の帰路を走ります。前方に大きな渋滞が発生する予報があり、渋滞前のSAがまだ届く間に早期休憩を提案できるかを確認します。旧アルゴリズムは渋滞が始まってから発火し、渋滞内の約90分先の地点しか示せません。
brief.en: Sleep-deprived from her fandom activities, she drives from Minatomirai toward Gotemba on a Saturday evening. A forecast shows a heavy jam ahead. Checks whether the forecast-based trigger proposes an early rest while a pre-jam SA is still reachable, versus the old algorithm which fires only after the jam starts and can only point to a spot deep inside the jam roughly 90 minutes away.

what_to_watch.ja: 渋滞予報を見て、渋滞前のSAが届く間に早期休憩が発火するか
what_to_watch.en: Whether the forecast fires an early rest proposal while a pre-jam SA is still reachable

what_to_watch.ja: 旧アルゴリズムが渋滞開始後にしか発火せず、約90分先の地点しか示せないこと
what_to_watch.en: Whether the old algorithm fires only after the jam starts, pointing to a spot ~90 min away

what_to_watch.ja: 休憩後の回復コンテンツが推し（Mrs. GREEN APPLE）になるか
what_to_watch.en: Whether post-rest recovery content is her oshi (Mrs. GREEN APPLE)

name.en: Ms. C, heading home from a fan event

narrative.ja: 20代前半の女性。推し活（イベント遠征）で寝不足のまま運転しています。一番の推しはMrs. GREEN APPLE、続いてあいみょん。疲れていても「まだいける」と感じやすく、疲労と眠気の自覚が薄いタイプです。
narrative.en: A woman in her early 20s, driving on little sleep after a fan event. Her top oshi is Mrs. GREEN APPLE, then Aimyon. She tends to feel 'still fine' even when tired, with low awareness of her own fatigue and drowsiness.

goals.ja: 無理なく安全に帰宅する
goals.en: Get home safely without pushing herself

goals.ja: 少し休んで推しの曲で気分を回復したい
goals.en: Rest a little and recover her mood with her oshi's music

preferences.ja: 推し（Mrs. GREEN APPLE / あいみょん）の曲を好む
preferences.en: Prefers songs by her oshi (Mrs. GREEN APPLE / Aimyon)

constraints.ja: 眠気の自覚が薄く、自分からは休憩を取りにくい
constraints.en: Low awareness of drowsiness; unlikely to take a break on her own

assumptions.ja: 出発時点で疲労・眠気はすでに水面下で高い
assumptions.en: Fatigue and drowsiness are already elevated under the surface at departure

narrative.ja: 土曜夕方、みなとみらいから御殿場までを走行します。前方で大きな渋滞が発生する予報が出ています。
narrative.en: A Saturday-evening drive from Minatomirai toward Gotemba, with a forecast of a heavy jam ahead.
